NONE: › a drug that contains opium, especially one that causes sleep
（尤指用於安眠的）鴉片劑，麻醉劑

example: [ + speech ] Power grows from the barrel of a gun, opined Mao.
毛澤東說，槍杆子裡面出政權。
[ + that ] Ernest Rutherford opined that his work on radioactive substances would be of little or no practical use.
歐內斯特‧盧瑟福認為，他對放射性物質的研究工作沒有多少或者沒有實際用處。

C: B1 [ C ] a thought or belief about something or someone

U: B2 [ U ] the thoughts or beliefs that a group of people have
C: B1 [ C ] a judgment about someone or something
B1 [ C ] a judgment made by an expert

example: What's your opinion about/on the matter?
你對這件事有甚麼看法？
People tend to have strong opinions on capital punishment.
人們往往對死刑抱有強烈的觀點。
He didn't express/give an opinion on the matter.
他沒有就此事發表意見。
Who, in your opinion, (= who do you think) is the best soccer player in the world today?
依你所見，誰是當今世界最優秀的足球員？
He's very much of the opinion that alternative medicine is a waste of time.
他頑固地認為替代療法是浪費時間。
Eventually, the government will have to take notice of public opinion.
最終，政府將不得不注意民意所向。
There is a diverse range of opinion on the issue.
在這個問題上，意見五花八門。
There was a difference of opinion as to the desirability of the project.
對於該計劃是否可取有不同的看法。
Opinion is divided as to whether the treatment actually works.
對於治療是否真的有效意見不一。
Both performances were excellent, it's simply a matter of opinion as to whose was better.
兩場表演都很好，孰優孰劣只是見仁見智的事情。
Her opinion of Adam changed after he was so helpful at the wedding.
亞當在婚禮上那麼熱心幫忙，從此以後她對他的看法改變了。
She has a good/high opinion of his abilities (= thinks he is good).
她對他的能力評價甚高。
I have a pretty bad/low/poor opinion of my sister's boyfriend (= I do not like or approve of him).
我對我姐姐的男友評價很壞／低／差。
He has a very high opinion of himself (= thinks he is very skilled/clever in a way that is annoying).
他自視甚高。
My doctor has referred me to a specialist for a second opinion on the results of my blood test.
我的醫生將我轉診給一位專科醫生，以對我的驗血結果作再次鑒定。

NONE: › an occasion when people are asked questions to discover what they think about a subject

example: The latest opinion poll shows that the president's popularity has declined.
最近的民意調查顯示，總統的支持率有所下降。

NONE: › An opinionated person is certain about their beliefs, and expresses their ideas strongly and often.
固執己見的；武斷的；剛愎自用的

example: He was opinionated and selfish, but undeniably clever.
他雖然固執己見而且自私自利，不過確實很聰明。

example: Constipation is the most common side effect of any opioid.
便秘是類鴉片藥品最常見的副作用。
